name: Rock Throwing
body:
You have learned to throw the stones you catch with deadly precision.

Prerequisite(s) Jötunfolk with the Rock Catching racial trait

Benefit(s) You are accomplished at throwing boulders, stones, and rocks and gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls with such. You can hurl rocks up to two categories smaller than its size.

A rock is any large, bulky, and relatively regularly shaped object made of any material with a hardness of at least 5.

A thrown rock has a range increment of 120 feet. Jötunfolk can hurl the rock up to five range increments. Damage from a thrown rock is 2d6 plus 1 ½ times your Strength bonus.
